author: CrakSEO
name: SERP API: Live Google Search Results by CrakSEO
description: SERP API for SEO: live Google search results and keyword rankings by location and device, with SERP features, Google AI Overview sources, Google Maps and Bing.

tools.name: get_api_credit_balance
tools.description: Free: API credit balance, availability and pricing for SEO data calls. Call first to confirm the connection.

tools.name: check_google_rankings
tools.description: Check Google rankings: the live Google position and ranking URL of a domain for up to 10 keywords in one country, with the top competing domains. Costs API credits per keyword.

domain.description: Domain or URL, for example example.com. Protocol and www are ignored.

items.description: Search query exactly as a user would type it.

keywords.description: Up to 10 keywords to check, one live Google search each.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

location.description: Optional exact location name for city-level results, for example "Austin,Texas,United States". Overrides country.

depth.description: How deep to look for the domain, 10 to 100 results. Default 30.

tools.name: get_google_serp
tools.description: Google SERP API: live Google search results for any keyword, country and device, with organic positions, titles, URLs, SERP features and AI Overview sources. Costs API credits per call.

keyword.description: Search query exactly as a user would type it.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

location.description: Optional exact location name for city-level results, for example "Austin,Texas,United States". Overrides country.

depth.description: How many results to fetch, 10 to 100. Each extra page of 10 costs more. Default 10.

tools.name: get_bing_serp
tools.description: Bing SERP API: live Bing search results for any keyword and country, with organic positions, titles and URLs. Bing results also power DuckDuckGo and other engines. Costs API credits per call.

keyword.description: Search query exactly as a user would type it.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

location.description: Optional exact location name for city-level results, for example "Austin,Texas,United States". Overrides country.

depth.description: How many results to fetch, 10 to 100. Default 10.

tools.name: get_ai_overview_sources
tools.description: AI Overview sources: whether Google shows an AI Overview for a keyword, its text, every page it cites, and whether a given domain is cited. Costs API credits per call.

keyword.description: Search query exactly as a user would type it.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

location.description: Optional exact location name for city-level results, for example "Austin,Texas,United States". Overrides country.

domain.description: Optional domain to check for a citation, for example example.com.

tools.name: check_google_maps_rankings
tools.description: Google Maps rankings: the local results for a keyword in a city, with rank, rating, review count, category and address, and the position of a given business. Costs API credits per call.

keyword.description: Search query exactly as a user would type it.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the search market, for example US, GB, DE or IN. Default US.

language.description: Language code of the search market, for example en, de or pt-BR. Default en.

location.description: Exact location name of the city, for example "Austin,Texas,United States".

business.description: Optional business name or domain to find in the results.

depth.description: How many map results to fetch, 10 to 100. Default 20.
